titel: Trapped on the Roof: The Killing of a correctional officer

einzeiler: A 2012 prison riot at a private Mississippi facility killed a young officer.
kurzfassung: On May 20, 2012, a gang fight inside the Adams County Correctional Center escalated into a major riot involving hundreds of inmates. Senior Correctional Officer Catlin Carithers was called in on his day off and cornered on the roof, where he was fatally beaten. Subsequent investigations revealed prior warnings about a hit list, leading to criminal convictions and lawsuits against the prison operator.
stichpunkte: Adams County Correctional Center in Mississippi was a privately run federal facility holding immigration-related inmates.
A yard fight on May 20, 2012, quickly escalated into a multi-hour riot involving around 300 core participants.
Inmates used fires, sticks, and homemade weapons while taking control of parts of the facility.
Senior Correctional Officer Catlin Carithers, called in on his day off, went onto the roof with tear gas.
Inmates climbed food carts to reach the roof, where Carithers was cornered and beaten to death with blunt objects and metal rods.
The attack resulted in the death of Carithers, injuries to 17 employees and three inmates, and over a million dollars in damage.
Inmate informants had previously warned security about a hit list targeting specific officers and a demanded meeting with the warden.
Prosecutors secured murder and long sentences for the men tied to the killing, and the victim's family filed lawsuits over understaffing and ignored warnings.

clips.hook: Prison riots are usually sold as sudden
clips.text: Despite being framed as unpredictable events, the uprising was preceded by clear warning memos, blacklists, and accessible rooftop infrastructure.

beschreibung: On May 20, 2012, a gang fight inside a privately run Mississippi prison exploded into a multi-hour riot that left the facility in chaos. Twenty-four-year-old Senior Correctional Officer Catlin Carithers, called in on his day off, was cornered and beaten to death on the roof after inmates used food carts as a makeshift ladder to reach him. This episode walks through how the riot escalated, what happened to Carithers, and how prosecutors later held accountable the men who took part in the attack and destroyed evidence in its wake.
